text: Carrington. The beating heart of Manchester United.
A place built on hard work, on loyalty, and on a deep, unshakeable hatred of Leeds.
delivery: same gravity all the way, then lean on 'hatred of Leeds'

text: But one man believes the club has a mole.
Shhh. I am not here.
I am a defender. My job is to smell danger before it happens.
delivery: talking head: calm, proud, very sincere

text: And this building smells of Leeds.
delivery: quiet, ominous, a little sniff before 'Leeds'

text: Jason Wilcox. Director of football. Look at his career.
delivery: like a detective presenting the suspect

text: Blackburn. He won the league against United.
Leeds. I don't need to explain.
delivery: flat, disgusted; the name says it all

text: Manchester City.
Southampton. Okay, Southampton is fine.
This is not a CV. This is a criminal record.
Every day, he drinks his tea from a white mug. Why white, Jason? Why always white?
delivery: building; 'Why white, Jason?' to the ceiling, unhinged

text: When United score, he claps like this.
delivery: flat; then he does one limp clap

text: When Leeds score, I hear him in the toilet. Screaming.
In twenty nineteen, Leeds were caught spying on another club's training ground.
Lisandro considers this a tutorial.
Day one of the surveillance operation.
delivery: serious, a little thrill in it

text: Target is in the office. Target is drinking tea. White mug. Of course.
delivery: whispered into a wrist like a secret agent

text: Absolutely. We're fully aligned. Red through and through. One club, one vision, one process.
delivery: smooth corporate phone voice, very pleased with himself

text: At two fifty-eight, the director of football locked his door.
At two fifty-nine, he closed the blinds.
And at three o'clock... he let it breathe.
delivery: long pause after 'three o'clock'; 'he let it breathe' almost tender

text: Come on, Leeds. Come on, lads.
delivery: an intimate whisper to the laptop

text: Madre mía.
Yes! Get in! Marching on together!
delivery: full-throated joy, singing the last two words

text: I knew it!
delivery: THE BIG ONE: a triumphant, furious shout

text: The mole had been found. The plant did not survive.
delivery: deadpan; a beat before 'The plant did not survive'

text: Lisandro! This isn't what it looks like.
It looks like Leeds.
It's scouting. Data-led opposition scouting. I'm immersing myself in the enemy.
In their shirt?
Method scouting. It's very modern. You wouldn't understand, you were in a plant.
delivery: trying to sound confident and failing

text: Turn around.
You signed your own shirt?
It was a difficult time for me.
Oh, that's never a penalty, ref!
delivery: he can't help it: a proper fan's shout at the laptop

text: Say it.
Say what?
Leeds are rubbish.
Leeds are... r... really well coached, to be fair.
delivery: straining to say it like it physically hurts, then it comes out warm and relieved

text: He cannot say it. He is sick.
delivery: to camera, heartbroken, like a doctor with bad news

text: Mr Wilcox requested a right of reply.
Slide one. My commitment to Manchester United, as a percentage. Up eleven percent on last season.
Up from what?
We don't need to get into the baseline.
The presentation lasted seventy minutes.
Seventy minutes of PowerPoint. You know who else does this? Bielsa. Leeds. Case closed.
delivery: talking head: building to a triumphant 'Case closed'

text: I bleed red. I always have.
delivery: talking head: sincere, hand on heart

text: There might be a bit of white in there. That's medical.
delivery: quieter, avoiding eye contact; rushed 'That's medical'

text: So I go to the top. Omar will know what to do.
Omar! We have a mole!
I knew it.
Omar Berrada joined United from Manchester City. Lisandro had not done the reading.
delivery: dry; a beat before 'Lisandro had not done the reading'

text: That night, Lisandro Martinez believed he was the last loyal man at Carrington.
Vamos, Alexis. Vamos, hermano.
I knew it!
delivery: the same triumphant shout Licho did

text: It's Argentina! It's different!
He plays for Liverpool, Lisandro!
It's a red shirt.
Next time, on All or Something: Sir Jim, and his other football club.
Shhh. We are not here.
delivery: hissed whisper (the same as his first line)

text: We're not here.
delivery: whispered back, very pleased to be included
